subject.title: fix: preserve zero sequence ids in sdk events

question: Should normalized SDK IDs intentionally change for protocol-valid zero components, accepting the bounded replay/dedupe-key transition for existing source consumers?
rationale: The implementation is technically correct, but normalized IDs are documented as stable replay and dedupe cursors, so accepting the representation change is a compatibility choice for the SDK owner.

options.title: Accept the corrected identifier
options.body: After the current type-test gate passes, merge the patch and treat zero-preserving IDs as the canonical alpha SDK behavior.

options.title: Preserve the existing representation
options.body: Decline the patch and retain the current zero-omitting ID format until an explicit identifier-versioning or migration design exists.

recommendation.title: Accept the corrected identifier
recommendation.body: After the current type-test gate passes, merge the patch and treat zero-preserving IDs as the canonical alpha SDK behavior.
